data.gender_notes: Anizah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anizah is derived from the Arabic word 'Anaza' which means 'to protect' or 'to guard'. In Islamic context, Anizah is a spiritual name for a girl, symbolizing one who safeguards her faith, family, and values. The name Anizah carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anizah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
